## Class and boundaries

Concept changed: authority to inspect the persisted physical evidence used by
served connection, publication, receiver-effect, numeric and loop/agent proofs.
Selected query interpretation belongs to the existing storage domain, not a
raw SQL handle carried through a general served fixture. The chosen working
class is this finite readback/consumer group; the parent remains the complete
test persistence-authority migration in #2542/#2151. These issues began with
symptoms, but this batch is an enumerated whole-owner/caller continuation, not
one repaired assertion. No claim of zero debt, final completion, runtime
semantics change, public process qualification or merge readiness is made.

The finite transform covers32 declarations in15 served files. Twelve full
served-fixture arguments become their exact consumed roles; semanticNumericOutput
loses its unused SQL parameter. Eleven direct extension calls and24 earlier
calls are propagated by the existing typed driver. requireForkReceiverEffect
retains its full carrier because it is passed as a function value; its fixed
reads move, but its remaining capability is not concealed or credited away.
The prospective post-revision refusal helper and two roots do not change.

The compiler checks the signed original, repaired and final candidates. A
discarded SQL argument must be a pure resolved SQL identifier or a field on the
original served carrier: effectful expressions, foreign/shadowed targets and
ellipsis refuse. The finite replay accepts only exact Before or exact After,
rejects foreign source and is idempotent. Business/error/logging/sleep/deadline
calls are conserved after the exact parameter rename. No query callback,
arbitrary expression/table selector, raw opener fallback or second coordinator
is introduced. The existing native read-role validation, original reader and
InspectSnapshot lifetime own every observation.
